item.description:
- The menu bar icon and the recording pill now show the Roundhand mark, the quotation mark from the app icon, instead of a microphone and a dot. In the menu bar the mark sits in a filled square while you dictate and gains a dot while a meeting records; in the pill it breathes, dims and takes the warning colour just as the dot did. - Opening Roundhand from the Dock, Spotlight or Finder now shows the main window the same way Open Roundhand in the menu bar does, with the "Hold Fn and speak" hint, the tip card for each page and the dots on new tips. Before, a window opened that way showed none of them. - Each page of the main window except Insights can show a short How it works card with an animated example. Press Got it to fold it away; the How it works button at the top brings it back. - When a meeting cannot be processed, Roundhand now tells you: a card appears, and the meeting stays in Notetaker as "Not processed" with Try again and Delete recording. Its recording is kept for 7 days so you can try again. Before, the meeting disappeared without a message and its recording was deleted. - Your history setting in Data and privacy now removes old meetings (with their kept recordings and screenshots) and old dictations even when you do not dictate: they are cleared when Roundhand starts and after each meeting finishes processing. - The meeting cards ("Meeting over?", the note after a recording stops on its own, the microphone-only notice and the offer to record) are now hidden from screen shares and screenshots, like the live transcript window. You still see them on your screen. - Meetings now use your dictionary: a dictionary word shows correctly in the live transcript, the saved transcript, Copy all, the Markdown export and find, and summaries spell your dictionary words, and the names from Name speakers when you choose Generate summary, your way. After you name speakers, close misspellings of those names in that meeting's transcript, summary and action items show the right spelling. The saved text is not changed, so removing a name or a dictionary entry brings back what was heard. - An imported recording is now kept for your full history period counted from the day you import it, so importing an older recording no longer gets it deleted right away. The note still shows the date the recording was made. - A meeting interrupted by a crash after its transcript was saved now finishes on the next launch instead of showing as failed, and Try again recovers one that already did. - Meeting summaries now use Claude Haiku 5.5, and so does cleanup on a Free or Pro plan. If you use your own key and choose Claude Haiku 5.5, cleanup now skips the model's thinking step, so it comes back sooner. - Dictation and meeting recording with a Bluetooth headset no longer crash or stop working without a word when the headset's microphone switches over: Roundhand waits for the switch to finish, keeps recording, and if the microphone still does not respond it says so. A microphone you choose in Settings now records even when your default microphone is a different kind of device, such as a Bluetooth headset. Unplugging the microphone you are recording with no longer pauses recording: Roundhand moves to your next microphone straight away.
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac and macOS 14 or later.

- The free trial of cloud cleanup now lasts 30 days instead of 15. - "This is me" now learns your voice from any meeting note, not only the one just processed. - A meeting with no speech no longer asks for a summary: it says no speech was found instead. - Import an audio or video recording into the Notetaker to get a transcript, speakers and a summary. The audio is decoded and transcribed on your Mac; only the transcript text is sent, for the summary.
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac and macOS 14 or later.

- Meeting summaries with an Anthropic key now use a newer, larger-context model, so long meetings are summarized in one pass. - When a meeting summary is written, the meeting now gets a short title from it instead of the app name and time. - Cloud cleanup no longer inserts text that was already in your document in front of, or instead of, what you just said. When it tries, Roundhand inserts your own words with the offline cleanup, and History shows "LLM repeated the document". - With no cleanup provider set, Notes now leaves a sentence like "We need to buy eggs, milk, bread and butter." as a sentence instead of turning its opening words into a heading. - When a meeting recording stops on its own and no summary will be written (no API key, or Local-only mode on), the notice now says the transcript is being saved instead of promising a summary. - A meeting summary that fails because your API key was rejected, your credits ran out or your free trial ended now says so, instead of saying the service could not be reached. - You can record the next meeting as soon as you stop the last one. Meetings still being processed wait their turn, each with its own row in the Notetaker, and pick up where they left off if Roundhand quits. - If you clicked "Don't ask again" on the record-this-meeting card, you can now turn the card back on: Settings > General > Meetings, or the Notetaker section, has an "Ask to record when a call starts" switch. - The last word of a dictation is no longer cut off when you release the key: Roundhand keeps listening for a moment after you let go. - Button labels no longer wrap onto two lines. In a meeting's Delete dialog, "Delete audio only" is now "Delete audio", and the dialog says what each choice removes. - The message shown when an account reaches its device limit now counts devices rather than Macs.
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac and macOS 14 or later.
